# remote-cloud-init-file (Resource)

Generate a yaml block suitable for a write_files entry in cloud-init



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) The owning group of the target file
- `path` (String) The path to the file on the target system
- `permissions` (String) The permissions of the target file. Must be an octal string between 0 and 77777
- `user` (String) The owning user of the target file

### Optional

- `encode_as` (String) If set, it assumes file_contents is valid HCL and will be converted to json or yaml
- `encoding` (String) If set to b64, content will be base64 encoded. If set to gzip, it will be gzipped then base64 encoded
- `file_contents` (String, Sensitive) The contents of the file to be written. Omit to write an empty file to the target system

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive) The rendered YAML of the directive, suitable for inserting into a cloud-init's write_files list
- `content_sha256` (String) The SHA-256 checksum of the generated yaml
- `id` (String) The SHA-1 checksum of the generated yaml. Used for tracking state
